units.source_text: 这个时候，在场的众教众之中，有人大喊：“殉教！”

en.t: At that moment, from among the many believers present, someone shouted, “Martyrdom!”

units.source_text: “殉教！”声此起彼伏，入波涛汹涌。

en.t: Cries of “Martyrdom!” rose one after another, surging like stormy waves.

units.source_text: 罗连同情罪人，虽然自己沦为乞丐，也不为自己辩解，

en.t: Lorenzo had pitied the condemned man, and though he himself had fallen into beggary, he still offered no defense for himself,

units.source_text: 即使是如父亲般的神甫和如兄弟般的西美昂，

en.t: so that even the priest who was like a father to him and Simeon who was like a brother,

units.source_text: 都未能识出他高尚的品德，差点错失一个如此坚定的殉教士。

en.t: failed to recognize his noble virtue and almost let such a steadfast martyr slip away.
